Dr. H. M. Jorgens and family start this afternoon for Cave Hills. Messrs. Powers and Johnson, of Grand Rapids, Mich., came last night and start with E. G. Paddock, on their way to Spearfish. On his return trip, Mr. Paddock will bring back Mrs. Fred Willard.
